criteria.evidence_requirement: Verified active condition or reviewed record-completeness declaration for its absence.
criteria.source_quote:
The patient must have no confirmed active SYN-EXCLUDED-CONDITION at screening. A verified active
condition fails this criterion. Passing requires a reviewed record-completeness declaration supporting
absence at screening. No chart entry by itself is not evidence of absence; insufficient or contradictory
evidence yields UNKNOWN. Preserve active, resolved and suspected clinical states separately from
evidence verification.

criteria.evidence_requirement: Dated verified administration/reliable reported use, or reviewed no-use reconciliation covering the full window.
criteria.source_quote:
The patient must have no documented administration or reported use of SYN-CLASS-R during the 30
preceding calendar days: [2026-10-01 00:00, 2026-10-31 00:00) in Europe/Athens. The start is included;
the end is excluded. Verified use overlapping this window fails. Passing requires explicitly reviewed no-use
reconciliation covering the entire window. An order or dispense alone, missing dates, contradictory sources
or an uncertain endpoint that could change overlap yields UNKNOWN. Do not infer stop dates or equate
prescription or supply with ingestion.

criteria.evidence_requirement: Sourced birth date with sufficient precision for age at screening.
criteria.source_quote:
The patient must be 40 to 70 years old, inclusive, on 2026-10-31. Calculate age from a sourced birth date
using the site-local screening date. If birth-date precision cannot establish the age conclusively, return
UNKNOWN. A confirmed age outside this inclusive range fails this criterion.

criteria.evidence_requirement: Verified condition code or synthetic adjudicated diagnosis note as of screening.
criteria.source_quote:
The patient must have a confirmed diagnosis of SYN-CONDITION-A at screening. Accept a verified
condition code or a synthetic adjudicated note establishing that diagnosis. An ambiguous or unconfirmed
label does not establish the diagnosis and yields UNKNOWN. This criterion defines no disease-severity,
symptom-duration or genotype restriction.

criteria.evidence_requirement: Latest relevant numeric eGFR with valid specimen date, provenance and reviewed unit.
criteria.source_quote:
The latest relevant eGFR must be at least 60 mL/min/1.73m². Its specimen local calendar date must be in
[2026-10-01, 2026-10-31], including both endpoints. Use specimen date, not issued, recorded or ingestion
time. Missing or stale evidence yields UNKNOWN; unsupported units yield UNKNOWN unless a reviewed
conversion exists. A valid timely value below 60 fails. This threshold is fictional and is not a clinical
recommendation.

criteria.evidence_requirement: Confirmed dated administration or reliable documented use during participation.
criteria.source_quote:
During human-recorded participation, a new confirmed administration or documented use of
SYN-CLASS-R requires investigator review. Reliable dated administration or reported-use evidence
triggers a CONFIRMED_PROTOCOL_CONFLICT finding linked to a review case. Evaluate
clinical-effective time; preserve the earlier screening assessment. This is a rule conflict, not a determination
of harm. It authorizes no automatic treatment change or withdrawal.

criteria.evidence_requirement: Dated restricted-class order/dispense with no confirmed use, requiring human reconciliation.
criteria.source_quote:
During human-recorded participation, a new order or dispense of SYN-CLASS-R without confirmed use
requires medication reconciliation. Open a POTENTIAL_SAFETY_REVIEW case; actual exposure remains
unknown. Retrieve administration and reported-use evidence where available. An order or dispense is not
proof of ingestion and must not be reported as a confirmed-use conflict. A clinician supplies or reviews any
reconciliation evidence.

criteria.evidence_requirement: New synthetic numeric eGFR below the fictional threshold during participation, with valid units and specimen/effective time.
criteria.source_quote:
During human-recorded participation, a new synthetic eGFR result below 60 mL/min/1.73m² requires clinical
review. Use the clinical specimen/effective time, valid units and provenance. The result opens a
rule-specific monitoring finding for human assessment; it is not a diagnosis, toxicity determination or
autonomous withdrawal instruction. This rule adds no scheduled testing requirement or new screening
criterion.
